details: The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) Services PMI for September 2026 showed the "Prices Paid" index rising to 74.0, its highest level since July 2022. This indicates persistent inflationary pressures within the services sector, despite a slight dip in the overall PMI to 54.9. This data could reinforce the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance, potentially leading to prolonged higher interest rates.
title: US Services Prices Hit 4-Year High, Fuels Rate Hike Concerns.

details: The US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has officially withdrawn two proposed rules that would have imposed strict reporting and record-keeping requirements on transactions involving self-custody crypto wallets and mixers. The Treasury cited concerns about "chilling effects on legitimate activity" and large reporting burdens as reasons for the withdrawal.
title: FinCEN Scraps Crypto Mixer & Self-Custody Wallet Surveillance Rules.

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has paused the review of new cryptocurrency exchange-traded fund (ETF) applications as the federal fiscal year began on October 1, 2026, without an approved budget. This funding lapse means that no new approval orders or comment letters can be issued, effectively delaying the launch of new crypto ETFs. Existing listed products are not affected and can continue trading.
sourceName: SEC Funding Lapse Freezes Crypto ETF Reviews, Leaving Issuers in Limbo
title: SEC Freezes New Crypto ETF Reviews Due to Funding Lapse.
